newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh president fires a deputy prime minister.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh president fires a deputy prime minister.

text.p: Kazakhstan's President Nursultan Nazarbayev relieved First Deputy Prime Minister Nigmatzhan Isingarin of his post on Monday, state television said.
The decree gave no reason for Isingarin's departure.
In March Nazarbayev called for cuts in the unwieldy state machinery of Kazakhstan, a vast Central Asian country five times the size of France but populated by just 16.7 million people.

In June Deputy Prime Minister Dyusenbay Duysenov was appointed Energy and Natural Resources Minister. Earlier this month another deputy prime minister, Zhanybek Karibzhanov, was named mayor of Akmola, a northwestern town designated the new Kazakh capital.
Altogether Prime Minister Akezhan Kazhegeldin now has four deputies.
